paper_title: Morphosyntactic probing of multilingual BERT models
caption: The effect of and by language family. Error bars indicate the standard deviation.
model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the effect for different language families, represented by four distinct model types. The horizontal axis displays the language families—IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic—arranged alphabetically. The vertical axis, labeled “effect,” is a linear scale ranging from 0 to 40 with tick marks at 10-unit intervals. For each language family, there are four bars representing four models: mBERT-targ, XLM-targ, mBERT-permute, and XLM-permute, indicated by light blue, dark blue, light green, and dark green color, respectively. Each bar displays an error bar extending vertically, indicating standard deviation. The shortest bar is the dark green bar representing XLM-permute for Uralic, with a height approximately at 2, while the tallest bar is the light blue bar representing mBERT-targ for IE-Baltic, reaching approximately a height of 23. No bars appear to be visually emphasized, and the chart does not demonstrate any specific sorting order, although categories are presented alphabetically.
